title: Juicy Nostalgic Croatian Pepper Stir-fry
description: A spicy and juicy dish featuring cayenne pepper, cure (preserved meat or seafood), with a dash of friendly flavors to evoke nostalgic memories.

ingredients.name: 1 cup cured meat or seafood chunks (e.g., prosciutto, pancetta, sausage)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and onion, sauté until softened, about 2 minutes.
Toss in the cured meat or seafood chunks. Cook for another 4-5 minutes until they start to brown slightly.
Stir in cayenne pepper and season with salt and pepper according to taste. Continue stirring for another minute to allow flavors to meld together.
Squeeze lemon juice over the dish, stirring gently to combine all ingredients well.
Serve hot as a side dish or over rice. Garnish with fresh parsley if desired.
